messages.subject: Shiny: Depending Choose Prompt
parts:
Dear All,
I am thinking about depending Choose prompt (selectizeInput).
The second "Choose prompt" depends on the first one.
The first one list the Studies by description (the second column in Studies dataframe: Studies[,2]).

The second Choose prompt lists the Cases ONLY in the selected study. To get cases

Cases <- getCasesList(cgds, Studies[selected row,1])

How can I capture the number of selected Study? 

Thanks
Karim

ui.R


 sidebarLayout(
   sidebarPanel(

# Select Studies
    selectizeInput('studies', 'Studies', choices = NULL, multiple = FALSE),


# Select Cases
   selectizeInput('cases', 'Cases', choices = NULL, multiple = FALSE),

))

mainPanel(
    verbatimTextOutput('Studies_values'),
)





server.R

## get Studies dataframe 
library(cgdsr)
  cgds<-CGDS("http://www.cbioportal.org/public-portal/")
  Studies <- getCancerStudies(cgds)

  updateSelectizeInput(session, 'studies', choices = Studies[,2])

  output$Studies_values <- renderPrint({
    list(List_Studies = input$studies)


## get Cases dataframe


Cases <- getCasesList(cgds, Studies[numberOfSelectedStudy,1])

......?
